Name: Farm Awards - Seasonal Ratings
Author: littlelodgegames
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Give every season a place in your farm’s story.

Farm Awards evaluates your progress across five categories, each contributing up to 20 points toward a seasonal score out of 100. Your total earns a one-to-five-star rating and, with rewards enabled, a gold payment.

You can check your current performance throughout the season. The This Season page previews your score and explains what contributes to each category. On the first morning of the next season, your completed results arrive by letter.

Farm Awards also keeps personal records, from your best earning day to your strongest farming season. Browse past results, compare your progress, and find something new to beat.

Targets adjust as your farm develops, winter uses reduced crop targets, and partial seasons are assessed according to the time recorded.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download and extract the mod archive.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Place the included
[/color]
[code]FarmReview[/code][color=#D4D4D8]folder inside your Stardew Valley
[/color]
[code]Mods[/code][color=#D4D4D8]folder.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Load your save and read the Farm Awards introduction letter.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]Open Farm Awards with [b]F10[/b] or the [b]medal tab on the left of the game menu[/b].[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Five scoring categories:[/b]
[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Farming:[/b] Crop harvests, crop variety, and shipped crop quality.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Ranching:[/b] Animals, animal products, and animal happiness.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Economy:[/b] Earnings, shipping, and artisan goods.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Community:[/b] Friendships, gifts, quests, and community contributions.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Exploration:[/b] Fishing, mining, combat, foraging, and artifact discoveries.[/color][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Seasonal scores out of 100[/b], with a one-to-five-star rating.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Gold awards:[/b] Default rewards range from [b]500g to 10,000g[/b], depending on the rating.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Live seasonal preview:[/b] See how the season would score if it ended today.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Personal records:[/b] Track your highest score, seasonal earnings, best earning day, harvests, catches, shipping totals, and more.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Season history:[/b] Browse recorded seasons with score bars and category totals.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Seasonal letters:[/b] Receive results, rewards, and newly broken records.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Four menu pages:[/b] This Season, Last Review, Records, and History.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Progression-aware targets:[/b] Expectations grow with the farm’s year.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Winter and partial-season adjustments.[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Configurable scoring and rewards:[/b] Adjust strictness, reward amounts, reward multipliers, and minimum recording time.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]GMCM mod support[/color][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Stardew Valley 1.6.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI 4.0 or later[/url], using a release compatible with your game.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Optional:[/b] Generic Mod Config Menu for in-game configuration. [/color][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Notes[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Farm Awards is the displayed name.[/b] The installation folder and internal files retain the name
[code]FarmReview[/code]to preserve compatibility with existing saves. Keep the supplied filenames unchanged.[/*]
[*]Works with new and existing saves.[/*]
[*]Installing mid-season begins recording from that point; it does not reconstruct the entire season’s history.[/*]
[*]By default, a partial season needs at least [b]seven recorded days[/b] to receive an award.[/*]
[*]Seasonal ratings reward activity across all five categories. Specialising in one activity can earn a strong category score without necessarily earning the highest overall rating.[/*]
[*]Default gold awards are:
[list]
[*][b]1 star:[/b] 500g.[/*]
[*][b]2 stars:[/b] 1,500g.[/*]
[*][b]3 stars:[/b] 3,000g.[/*]
[*][b]4 stars:[/b] 5,000g.[/*]
[*][b]5 stars:[/b] 10,000g.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]Gold rewards are paid automatically; reading the letter is not required to claim them.[/*]
[*]Multiplayer support is [b]host-only[/b].[/*]
[*]Results and rewards follow the game’s saving behaviour. Quitting without saving rolls back the day.[/*]
[*]Edit
[code]config.json[/code]after the first launch to adjust scoring, rewards, controls, and letters.[/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Description: A rating out of 100 for every season you farm, a reward to match, and a book of your farm's records.
